Streaming chat completion with tool/function call chunks

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ToolType, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chatStream({ messages: [{ content: "What's the weather?", role: "user" }], model: "gpt-4", tools: [{ function: { name: "get_weather", parameters: { properties: { city: { type: "string" } }, type: "object" } }, toolType: ToolType.Function }] });
  for await (const resultChunk of result) {
    console.log(resultChunk);
  }
}

void main();
```
